Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat steak because it was yummy and yummy. One day, Lily's mom asked her if she had any steak to eat. Lily was impatient but agreed and found a good steak that Lily really ate all of.

When her mom finished eating, Lily and her mom went outside to play. They played tag, tag, and even got a big steak for everyone to eat. Lily was so happy and couldn't wait to eat anything yummy steak to eat. The end.Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily
